name: io.github.mindstone/mcp-server-xero
title: Xero
description: Xero MCP server for invoices, contacts, payments, quotes, and financial reports.

environmentVariables.name: XERO_CLIENT_ID
environmentVariables.description: Client ID of your Xero Web app (Sign in with Xero) or Custom Connection.

environmentVariables.name: XERO_CLIENT_SECRET
environmentVariables.description: Client secret of your Xero Web app (Sign in with Xero) or Custom Connection.

environmentVariables.name: XERO_REFRESH_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: Optional refresh token from Sign in with Xero, for a Web app. Rebel saves it when you click Connect. With it, the client ID and secret are used as a Web app's, not a Custom Connection's.

environmentVariables.name: XERO_CLIENT_BEARER_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: Optional externally-managed Xero bearer token. When set, it takes precedence over the refresh token and the Custom Connection client credentials.
